title: Bear cub wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='27' r='11' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='27' r='11' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='27' r='6' fill='#c98a52'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='27' r='6' fill='#c98a52'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='32' fill='#a86a34'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='19' ry='14' fill='#e0b07a'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='61' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#5c3a1e'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='60' rx='1.8' ry='1.2' fill='#f7e0c0'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 65 q-6 6 -11 2' fill='none' stroke='#5c3a1e' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 65 q6 6 11 2' fill='none' stroke='#5c3a1e' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sunglasses lenses -->
  <rect x='22' y='40' width='24' height='16' rx='6' fill='#2f2f4f'/>
  <rect x='54' y='40' width='24' height='16' rx='6' fill='#2f2f4f'/>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <path d='M27 45 l6 0 -8 8 -2 0 z' fill='#8fa8d8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M59 45 l6 0 -8 8 -2 0 z' fill='#8fa8d8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='45' y='45' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4a4a72'/>
  <!-- temples -->
  <rect x='18' y='45' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4a4a72'/>
  <rect x='76' y='45' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#4a4a72'/>
</svg>
